verdict.rationale: Plan terms such as seat minimums or annual billing commitments are a fair question for a SaaS product like Jira, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers pricing pages, plan minimums or billing-commitment terms; it covers only features, integrations, APIs, sandboxes and community sentiment.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know whether my plan enforces a minimum seat count or annual billing commitment before I subscribe
